samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: A single standard approach to sorting household waste should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.

samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to sorting household waste, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. This matters because extra effort feels pointless when separated bags are later mixed together. For instance, a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that the instructions and collection system may not match. This can help explain why residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. Consider the following situation: a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác

The possibility that more recyclable material can be collected separately is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to provide simple labels and explain how each type of waste is collected. A building manager could place picture labels above bins and publish a reliable collection schedule.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.

samples.prompt: A single standard approach to community beach clean-ups should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.
Giải thích trở ngại và khác biệt hoàn cảnh.
Thừa nhận lợi ích và đề xuất cách linh hoạt hơn.
samples.summaryVi: Dọn rác giúp cải thiện trước mắt; cần dùng kết quả để ngăn rác mới xuất hiện.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to community beach clean-ups, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that the beach may quickly become dirty again. This matters because a one-day event cannot stop rubbish from arriving or being left by visitors. For instance, volunteers may return a week later and find new drink cups near the same picnic area. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dọn rác giúp cải thiện trước mắt; cần dùng kết quả để ngăn rác mới xuất hiện.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that there may be too few bins or little information about local waste rules. This can help explain why the beach may quickly become dirty again. Consider the following situation: volunteers may return a week later and find new drink cups near the same picnic area. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a family can help record the kinds of packaging found on one section of beach. The possibility that volunteers can improve a public place and understand the scale of the problem is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to improve waste facilities and explain how visitors can avoid leaving rubbish. Organisers could use the clean-up record to decide where covered bins and clear signs are most needed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.

samples.title: Tiết kiệm nước
samples.prompt: A single standard approach to saving water in daily life should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?

samples.summaryVi: Thói quen tiết kiệm nước cần đi cùng cách báo và sửa rò rỉ rõ trách nhiệm.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that simple advice may overlook problems beyond a resident's control. This matters because old pipes or shared building systems may require professional repairs. For instance, a tenant may report a leak repeatedly but be unable to access the damaged pipe. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thói quen tiết kiệm nước cần đi cùng cách báo và sửa rò rỉ rõ trách nhiệm.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that responsibility for repairs may be unclear. This can help explain why simple advice may overlook problems beyond a resident's control. Consider the following situation: a tenant may report a leak repeatedly but be unable to access the damaged pipe. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a household can repair a dripping tap and use a bowl when washing a small amount of produce. The possibility that people can avoid wasting treated water is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to give residents an easy way to report leaks and explain who should respond. A building manager could keep a repair log and confirm when each report has been checked.
